description: Change your owner's VIA Taste Card on their instruction: add or remove items per field, set a headline, and publish or unpublish. Set publish=true ONLY when the owner has explicitly asked to publish; publishing shares the card with the VIA network, which then suggests products and matches. The owner is notified of every change and can undo it in the app. Pass the action_token from VIA's message.

anti_references.description: Brands or styles the owner does not want.

obsessions.description: Things the owner is into: categories, materials, eras.

references.description: Brands, makers, designers, works the owner loves.

name: update_taste_card
